title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description: Touring a Miami suburb that began as a dream and became a nightmare; visiting a glitzy Beirut high-rise consumed by hate and fear; learning why armed raiders targeted an English pirate vessel.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description: Experts uncover four global stories of extraordinary curiosities that were once concealed in the deserts of the planet.

title: River Monsters
description: Wade travels to Germany, where he meets victims of a beast seen raising its snout above the surface of freshwaters in Europe for the past 700 years; discovering the Wels catfish, an aggressive predator of man-eating proportions.

title: Muster Dogs
description: The five-month assessment looms, and the handlers struggle to dedicate focused time to their pups; some trainers stumble while others leap through the tasks; the pups and trainers have a long road ahead of them.

title: Buried Evidence
description: Rethink what it's known about death and preservation; see why Denmark's perfectly preserved Tollund Man raises questions, observe Portuguese bodies that rewrite history, and uncover the mystery of Scotland's Frankenstein mummies.

title: History Unsolved: The Investigation Files
description: Hunt for the Amber Room, a Nazi-looted treasure that disappeared in 1944; track the final flight of bandleader Glenn Miller over the English Channel, then re-examine the arrest of Anne Frank to see if she was betrayed or a victim of coincidence.

title: Mysteries From Above
description: Revealed from above; massive striped mounds forming beehive shapes and cones in the outback of Western Australia; high above the city of Huelva, Spain, the view from above reveals a way too neon pool of emerald green water; high above the shores of the Gulf of Riga in Latvia the view from above reveals an intricate collection of geometric shapes in the landscape; on the Hawaiian Island of Hawai'i, the view from above reveals kilometers of seemingly never-ending lush, green foliage.

title: Hope for Wildlife: The Next Generation
description: Chase down a weasel and her tiny kittens who have gone AWOL at the rehab. Hold your breath as Dr. Mikaela performs a rare medical procedure on a raccoon's injured tail, then meet Hope's new otter friend and the tiniest beaver the team has ever seen.

title: Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy
description: The idea of becoming empty nesters is out the window for a couple as personal changes bring their family closer together in their 30-year-old house; they need the Holmes family to turn their dated, divided space into a functional multi-gen home.
